phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Government Refinancing Need

current_observed_series.concept: Annual Ministry of Finance government-debt principal repayments/refinancing component, billion RON

resolved_blocker.prior_reason: The previous 2017-2023 history contained only seven annual observations with mixed FINAL/OPERATIVE status and lacked a frozen sufficiency/revision rule.
resolved_blocker.resolution: A frozen historical-continuity promotion contract now governs selection and revisions. Official MoF sources provide twelve consecutive completed-year observations for 2013-2024, all with accepted observed/retrospective execution statuses, while estimates/plans are explicitly retained only as discarded provenance candidates.

semantic_limits: The series is the refinancing/principal-repayment component, not gross financing need.
The series does not identify matched old/new interest rates.
The series does not identify the repricing share m[t].
Observed refinancing need does not validate the government refinancing/effective-rate mechanism.

official_gross_financing_need_definition.concept: Gross financing needs are a flow/liquidity concept combining the government deficit, debt redemptions and stock-flow adjustments; they are not the realized principal actually refinanced or contractually refixed.

ministry_financing_need_example.source: Romania Ministry of Finance Government Debt Management Strategy 2024-2026, Table 8
ministry_financing_need_example.definition_limit: The Ministry table mixes operative execution with forecasts. Its refinancing component is defined from principal repayments and government-security refinancing on the stated national-law debt boundary; it does not identify matched realized repricing events or the model transition share m[t].

prohibited_shortcuts: treat gross financing need as realized principal refinanced
treat debt maturing within one year as debt actually repriced
treat debt refixing within one year as realized refinancing
mix operative-execution and forecast vintages as one observed historical series without a preregistered revision rule
use issuance size as the principal replacing a specific maturity
infer the government repricing parameter m[t] from aggregate financing needs
